Make a Slack Bot

Make a slack bot that can respond to custom slash commands!

Preview guide

Submission requirements

  1. 1

    Your bot is live and responds to messages
  2. 2

    There are at least 3 different commands / functions
  3. 3

    Your commands don’t collide with anyone elses’
  4. 4

    Your bot is live 24/7, even when your laptop is closed

Prizes

  • Not rated

    Projects shipped to this mission will not be rated and will instead get a fixed payout.

    Fixed payout

    Rather than being rated, projects shipped to this fixed-payout mission will get: 30 stardust instead.

    Once you've shipped once to the mission, future ships will be rated normally, so if you want to work on a project for this mission beyond the base requirements, ship once when you've completed the base requirements and then work on adding new features and reship.

  • 30 stardust

    Yours to spend in the shop!
